_comment: Where Lafayette Square's data wells are. Shape: cartograph/sources.js.
_ls_is_reference_consumer_one: ⛔ LS is the mould the kit was cast around, not the subject. This file exists so bake-content.js#loadParcels could stop hardcoding LS's filenames for every town in the world — it changes nothing about LS's own pour.
_landUseCodes_why: null = self-describing/not needed here. LS sits entirely in St. Louis City, whose AsrLandUse1 codes are read by the stl-assessor-numeric ranges in bake-content.js#classifyUse; the county-land-use-codes.csv decode table is a COUNTY artifact and LS has no county parcels. (LS also has no content/ dir at all — INTAKE-CATALOGUE §3.5 T3 — so bake-content refuses it without --force.)
_state_wells: The wells are taken from the state record (cartograph/states/mo.mjs) and resolved by cartograph/sources.js; this file declares only what the town takes and how it selects.
_cropland_why: USDA's national Cropland Data Layer (cartograph/cdl.mjs): crop rows grow where OSM maps a field and, where it maps none, where the CDL reads crop (Jacob, 2026-10-05). 2024 is the latest year fetched.
